definition: the extra effectiveness or success achieved when two or more businesses or people work together
definition_cn: 协同效应；两家或多方合作产生的额外效益
example: The merger is expected to generate significant synergy between the two firms.
example_cn: 此次合并有望在两公司之间产生显著的协同效应。
mnemonic: syn-共同，ergy联想到energy，合在一起就是「共同发力」的能量

definition: a typical example or model of something; a way of thinking about or doing something
definition_cn: 范式；典范；做事或思考的模式
example: Digital transformation has forced a paradigm shift in traditional retail.
example_cn: 数字化转型迫使传统零售业发生了范式转移。
mnemonic: pa-爬，ra-上，digm-地基，爬上新地基=「爬上新模式」

definition: the action of selling off a subsidiary business or investment
definition_cn: 剥离；出售子公司或资产
example: The company announced the divestiture of its non-core units to focus on cloud services.
example_cn: 公司宣布剥离非核心部门，以专注云服务。
mnemonic: di-分，vest-背心，iture-过程，把背心分开=「把资产分开剥离」

definition: a person or company that currently holds a particular position or market role; holding a current office
definition_cn: 现任者；现有企业；在职的
example: The incumbent telecom operators face stiff competition from new entrants.
example_cn: 现有的电信运营商面临着来自新进入者的激烈竞争。
mnemonic: in-在里，cumb-躺，ent-人，躺在里面的人=「占着位子的人」

definition: a market structure dominated by a small number of large sellers or producers
definition_cn: 寡头垄断；由少数大型卖家控制的市场
example: The aircraft manufacturing sector is essentially an oligopoly.
example_cn: 飞机制造业本质上是一个寡头垄断市场。
mnemonic: oli-喔离，gopoly-够垄断，少数人离开群众就能「够垄断」

definition: to turn a product or service into a commodity where price becomes the only differentiator
definition_cn: 使商品化；让产品只剩价格差异
example: Cloud computing has begun to commoditize IT infrastructure.
example_cn: 云计算已开始将IT基础设施商品化。
mnemonic: commodity变来的动词，ity变ize，把有特色的东西变成「商品」

definition: the process of distinguishing a product or service from competitors to make it more attractive
definition_cn: 差异化；使产品区别于竞争对手的过程
example: Strong brand identity is key to successful differentiation.
example_cn: 鲜明的品牌识别是成功差异化的关键。
mnemonic: different不同的，iation名词，和别人不同=「差异化」

definition: a rapid increase in the number or amount of something
example: The proliferation of smartphones has reshaped consumer behavior.
example_cn: 智能手机的大量普及重塑了消费者行为。
mnemonic: pro-向前，life生命，ration-速率，生命向前飞速=「激增」

definition: to gradually take over or intrude upon someone else's territory, rights, or business
definition_cn: 蚕食；侵占（领地、权利或业务）
example: Tech giants continue to encroach on the traditional banking sector.
example_cn: 科技巨头持续蚕食传统银行业的市场份额。
mnemonic: en-往里，croach-爬虫，像虫子一样爬进来=「蚕食」

definition: the state or process of filling something to capacity so that no more can be added
definition_cn: 饱和；市场渗透率到达极限的状态
example: The smartphone market in developed countries has reached saturation.
example_cn: 发达国家的智能手机市场已达到饱和。
mnemonic: satur-饱满的，ation状态，吃饱了的状态=「饱和」

definition: to find a way around an obstacle or restriction, often cleverly
definition_cn: 规避；巧妙地绕过障碍或规定
example: We cannot circumvent the compliance procedures even to save time.
example_cn: 即使为了节省时间，我们也不能规避合规流程。
mnemonic: circum-绕圈，vent-来，绕圈过来=「绕过」障碍

definition: to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding
definition_cn: 证实；支持（说法、理论或发现）
example: The sales data corroborates the marketing team's hypothesis.
example_cn: 销售数据证实了营销团队的假设。
mnemonic: cor-共同，robo-萝卜，rate-速率，共同种萝卜的速度被「证实」一样快

definition: a situation in which no progress can be made because of disagreement
definition_cn: 僵局；因分歧而无法进展的局面
example: The contract talks reached a deadlock over payment terms.
example_cn: 合同谈判在付款条款上陷入了僵局。
mnemonic: dead死，lock锁，死锁=「僵局」

definition: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing; vividly expressing meaning
definition_cn: 雄辩的；有说服力的；生动表达含义的
example: Her eloquent pitch convinced the board to approve the budget.
example_cn: 她那有说服力的宣讲说服了董事会批准预算。
mnemonic: e-鹅，lo-咯，quent-腔调，鹅咯咯有腔调=「雄辩」

definition: of vital importance; crucial; or an essential or urgent thing
definition_cn: 紧急的；极重要的；必要的事
example: It is imperative that we submit the report before the audit begins.
example_cn: 我们在审计开始前提交报告是当务之急。
mnemonic: im-不，pera-拖拉，tive的，不能拖拉=「紧急的」

definition: communication or cooperation between people or organizations to facilitate a close working relationship
definition_cn: 联络；协调；保持密切工作关系的沟通
example: She serves as the liaison between engineering and product management.
example_cn: 她担任工程部与产品管理部之间的联络人。
mnemonic: li-联，aison-爱神，爱神负责「联络」姻缘

definition: intended to reduce hostility or conflict; showing willingness to reconcile
definition_cn: 安抚的；调和的；愿意和解的
example: A conciliatory tone helped resolve the dispute between the two departments.
example_cn: 一种安抚的语气有助于化解两个部门之间的争端。
mnemonic: con-共同，cili-类似silence安静，atory的，让大家都安静=「安抚」

definition: to say or do something again for emphasis or clarity
example: The manager reiterated the deadline during the morning briefing.
example_cn: 经理在早会上重申了截止日期。
mnemonic: re-再次，iterate-陈述，再次陈述=「重申」

definition: expressed clearly and in few words; brief but comprehensive
example: Please keep your update succinct so we can finish on time.
example_cn: 请保持汇报简洁，以便我们能准时结束。
mnemonic: suc-速，cinct-悉，快速熟悉=「简洁」

definition: to represent something as being smaller or less significant than it really is
example: To say the project was challenging would be to understate the difficulty.
example_cn: 说这个项目有挑战性，其实是在轻描淡写其难度。
mnemonic: under-下面，state-陈述，往低了说=「轻描淡写」

definition: the process of gradually paying off a debt or spreading the cost of an intangible asset over time
definition_cn: 摊销；分期偿还债务或分摊无形资产成本的过程
example: The amortization of the patent will be completed over ten years.
example_cn: 该专利的摊销将在十年内完成。
mnemonic: a-一，mor-毛，ti-剃，zation-化，一根毛一根毛剃掉=「摊销」分摊成本

definition: a formal agreement or promise in a contract, especially in loan terms
definition_cn: 契约条款；合同中的正式承诺（尤指贷款）
example: The bank imposed strict covenants regarding debt-to-equity ratios.
example_cn: 银行就债务股本比设定了严格的契约条款。
mnemonic: co-共同，ven-来，ant-蚂蚁，蚂蚁共同来签「契约」

definition: the intangible asset representing the value of a company's brand, reputation, and customer relationships
definition_cn: 商誉；企业品牌、声誉和客户关系的无形价值
example: The purchase price exceeded the book value, resulting in significant goodwill.
example_cn: 收购价超过账面价值，产生了大量商誉。
mnemonic: good好，will意愿，大家都愿意和你好=「商誉」好

definition: the state of being unable to pay debts owed; financial failure
definition_cn: 资不抵债；无力偿还债务的状态
example: The retailer filed for insolvency after several quarters of losses.
example_cn: 该零售商在连续几个季度亏损后申请了破产（资不抵债）。
mnemonic: in-不，solvency-偿付能力，没有偿付能力=「资不抵债」

definition: the availability of liquid assets to a company or market; ease of converting assets to cash
definition_cn: 流动性；资产变现的难易程度
example: Central banks injected liquidity to stabilize the financial markets.
example_cn: 央行向金融市场注入流动性以稳定市场。
mnemonic: liquid液体，ity性质，像水一样流动=「流动性」

definition: ongoing business expenses not directly attributed to creating a product or service
definition_cn: 间接费用；经常性管理费用（如租金、水电）
example: Remote work policies helped the firm cut its monthly overheads.
example_cn: 远程办公政策帮助公司削减了每月的间接费用。
mnemonic: over-在上方，heads-头，压在头上的费用=「间接管理费用」

definition: the process of assuming financial risk in exchange for a fee, as in insurance or securities issuance
definition_cn: 承保；包销；承担金融风险以换取费用的过程
example: The investment bank led the underwriting for the tech firm's IPO.
example_cn: 该投行主导了这家科技公司IPO的包销工作。
mnemonic: under-在下面，writing-写，在下面签字=「承保/包销」

definition: the liability to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse
definition_cn: 波动性；市场价格或情况的剧烈不稳定
example: Investors are nervous due to the increased volatility in foreign exchange markets.
example_cn: 由于外汇市场波动性加剧，投资者感到紧张。
mnemonic: volat-挥发，ility-性质，像酒精挥发一样不稳定=「波动性」

definition: the simultaneous buying and selling of assets in different markets to exploit price differences
definition_cn: 套利；利用不同市场价差同时买卖获利
example: Hedge funds often use algorithms to detect arbitrage opportunities within milliseconds.
example_cn: 对冲基金经常使用算法在毫秒内发现套利机会。
mnemonic: arbi-阿比，trage-揣着，阿比揣着钱两边跑=「套利」

definition: the ability of a company to meet its long-term debts and financial obligations
definition_cn: 偿付能力；公司履行长期债务和财务义务的能力
example: Regulators require annual solvency assessments for all insurance providers.
example_cn: 监管机构要求所有保险公司每年进行偿付能力评估。
mnemonic: solv-解决，ency能力，能解决债务=「偿付能力」

example: Other charges include fraud and illegal appropriation of land.
example_cn: 其他指控包括诈骗和非法占用土地。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 向前/名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「appropriation」

definition_cn: n (to)介绍；传入,引进；导言,导论,绪论
example: Pete, are you going to make the introductions?
example_cn: 皮特，你来作一下介绍吧。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 引导/名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「introduction」
synonyms: 介绍；引进；采用；入门；传入

definition_cn: v 决定,下决心；解决,裁决
example: Has anything been decided yet?
example_cn: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

example: He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
example_cn: 他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

example: Her voice was full of emotion.
example_cn: 她的声音充满了激情。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「emotion」

example: people who are intolerant of other people’s political beliefs
example_cn: 不能容忍他人政治信仰的人

definition_cn: n 名人，名流；著名，名声，名望
example: a sporting celebrity
example_cn: 体育明星
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「celebrity」

definition_cn: n 厄运,劫数; v 注定,命定
example: A sense of impending doom (= coming very soon ) gripped her.
example_cn: 她心头被一种大难临头的感觉所笼罩。
synonyms: 厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日

definition_cn: adj 常见的，屡见不鲜的; n 寻常的事物；平庸的东西
example: Inter-racial marriages have become commonplace.
example_cn: 不同种族间的通婚已经变得很常见。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同 之意 → 帮助记忆「commonplace」
synonyms: 老生常谈；司空见惯的事；普通的东西

example: a serious deterioration in relations between the two countries
example_cn: 两国关系的严重恶化
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「deterioration」

example: You have to take the top off to change the batteries .
example_cn: 你得把顶盖拿掉才能更换电池。

example: a collective decision made by all board members
example_cn: 董事会所有成员作出的集体决定
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同/形容词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「collective」
synonyms: 集体的；共同的；集合的；集体主义的

example: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
example_cn: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。
synonyms: 刺激；使活动；使活泼；使产生放射性

example: continuous economic growth
example_cn: 持续的经济增长
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同/形容词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「continuous」

definition_cn: n 性格；排列,部署；倾向,意向
example: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition.
example_cn: 这种骑乘不适合紧张型性格的人。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 放置/分开/否定 之意 → 帮助记忆「disposition」
synonyms: 处置；[心理]性情；[军]部署；倾向

example: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
example_cn: 这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 分开/否定/名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「distinction」
synonyms: 区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章

example: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
example_cn: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 分开/否定 之意 → 帮助记忆「disarm」

example: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
example_cn: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

example: Congratulations on a superb performance!
example_cn: 对精彩的演出表示祝贺！
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 携带/共同 之意 → 帮助记忆「congratulation」

example: a breezy and relaxed air of confidence
example_cn: 轻松自信的神态
synonyms: 有微风的；轻松愉快的；通风好的；活泼的

example: Every business has its own inherent risks.
example_cn: 每笔生意本身都有风险。
synonyms: 内在的；固有的；与生俱来的

example: new countermeasures against terrorism
example_cn: 对抗恐怖主义的新措施
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 结束 之意 → 帮助记忆「countermeasure」

example: ...a TV documentary on homelessness.
example_cn: …一部关于无家可归现象的电视记录片。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 名词后缀/形容词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「documentary」

example: In its broadest sense, dynamics includes nearly the whole of mechanics.
example_cn: 广义地说来, 动力学几乎包括了整个力学。

definition_cn: v 改善，改进；变得更好
example: a course for students wishing to improve their English
example_cn: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 向前 之意 → 帮助记忆「improve」

definition_cn: n 形状；形状；表格; v 组成,构成；形成
example: We oppose racism in all its forms.
example_cn: 我们反对各种形式的种族主义。
synonyms: 形式，形状；形态，外形；方式；表格
构成，组成；排列，组织；产生，塑造

definition_cn: n 柜台；计数器; adj&adv 相反(的); v 反对,反击
example: He wondered if the girl behind the counter recognised him.
example_cn: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。
synonyms: [数][电子][核][计量]计数器，计算器；[贸易]柜台；计算者

example: A new trade agreement is imminent.
example_cn: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

example: Part-time workers are considered dispensable.
example_cn: 兼职工作人员被认为是可有可无的。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 分开/否定/可…的 之意 → 帮助记忆「dispensable」

definition_cn: adj 亲切的,客气的;宽厚的,仁慈的
example: Sibyl was the most gracious, helpful, and generous person to work with.
example_cn: 西比尔非常和蔼，乐于助人，而且为人慷慨，和她共事最愉快。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 形容词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「gracious」
synonyms: 亲切的；高尚的；和蔼的；雅致的

example: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
example_cn: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

example: My bedroom carpet is green.
example_cn: 我卧室里的地毯是绿色的。
synonyms: 在…上铺地毯，把地毯铺在…上；斥责

example: The eggs of these fish adhere to plant leaves.
example_cn: 这些鱼产下的卵附着在植物叶片上。

example: Don't interfere in other's private concerns.
example_cn: 不要干涉别人的私事。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 带来/之间 之意 → 帮助记忆「interfere」

example: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
example_cn: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。
synonyms: 控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位

example: He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
example_cn: 他抱怨律师收费太高。

example: The issue of hunting is a source of contention.
example_cn: 狩猎问题是争论的焦点。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同/名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「contention」

definition_cn: adj 正确的；恰当的,端正的; v 矫正；改正,纠正
example: If my calculations are correct, we’re about ten miles from Exeter.
example_cn: 如果我计算得没错的话，我们离埃克塞特大约十英里。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同 之意 → 帮助记忆「correct」

definition_cn: v 衰退,堕落,蜕化; adj 堕落的; n 堕落者
example: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate.
example_cn: 不活动会使关节僵硬，骨骼因此可能会开始退化。

example: His attackers turned and fled.
example_cn: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

example: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
example_cn: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

example: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
example_cn: 即食餐因为方便销路好。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 来/共同 之意 → 帮助记忆「convenience」

definition_cn: n 绷带; v 用绷带扎缚
example: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
example_cn: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

example: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
example_cn: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同 之意 → 帮助记忆「contain」
synonyms: 包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）

example: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
example_cn: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

example: She looked back on those days with affection .
example_cn: 她深情地回顾那些日子。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 做/名词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「affection」
synonyms: 喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

example: the former Soviet Union
example_cn: 前苏联
synonyms: 模型，样板；起形成作用的人

example: Scientists first conceived the idea of the atomic bomb in the 1930’s.
example_cn: 在20世纪30年代，科学家第一次有了原子弹的设想。
mnemonic: 词根联想：含 共同/形容词后缀 之意 → 帮助记忆「conceive」

definition_cn: adv 尤其；特别，格外；专门地，主要地
example: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
example_cn: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

example: ...his severe emotional dysfunction was very clearly apparent.
example_cn: ...他情绪的严重异常是显而易见的。
